items.why: AMD leads the chip sector lower as Nvidia extends its losing streak and the AI selloff deepens.
The fear gauge jumps as the snowballing selloff in global markets has investors reaching for cover.
Nvidia extends its six day losing streak and slips to fourth in market cap as chips lead the AI rout.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape.

market_note: Nasdaq futures are down 3.37% and S&P futures down 1.78% as the AI selloff continues.
summary: Stocks are getting hit hard today, with the Nasdaq sinking and the major indexes heading for their worst week since liberation day as the Anthropic IPO fails to ease AI worries. The Dow is holding up while tech and chips lead the slide.
